newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down on Tokyo fall.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down on Tokyo fall.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices fell at the close on Tuesday after tracking a weak Tokyo futures market, traders said.
They said prices were soft on the absence of buying interest, and were pounded further by bearish sentiment in Tokyo. "It was dead on the business front," said a trader.

The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted the RSS1 buyer for June at 277.50 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.11), down 1.50 cents from Monday. The SMR20 buyer for June was priced one cent down at 262.50.
Malaysian markets are closed on Wednesday for Wesak Day.
Traders quoted the SMR20 at 261, SMR CV at 332, SMR 5 at 272, SMR L at 307, SMR 10 at 262.50 and drum latex at 227.
The INRO five-day moving indicator was quoted at 212.44 on May 19, against 210.95 on May 16. The daily indicator was unchanged at 214.59.
